description: Frontend enhancements: (1) Create Inspection History page (templates/inspections.html) with browsing, search by capture ID or date, filtering, and ability to reopen previous analyses. (2) Add Dashboard Summary section to the existing dashboard showing total inspections, confirmed cracks, average confidence, largest crack, average crack size, inspection duration, images captured today. (3) Add Export buttons (CSV, Excel, PDF) to the inspection history page. (4) Update dashboard.js to show the captured overlay image in the analysis panel (from /capture/image) while the live feed remains raw. (5) Add navigation link to Inspection History page. (6) Keep all existing styling, layout, and navigation intact.
steps: Create templates/inspections.html - a full page with the same navbar/footer as dashboard.html, containing: (a) Summary cards at top showing total inspections, confirmed cracks, average confidence, largest crack, average crack size, images today. (b) A search bar (search by capture ID or date). (c) Filter controls (date range, min confidence). (d) A responsive table/grid listing inspections with columns: Capture ID, Date, Classification, Confidence, Crack Length, Crack Width, Actions (view, download PDF). (e) Pagination controls. (f) Export buttons: Export CSV, Export Excel. The page fetches data from /api/inspections and /api/summary via JavaScript.

Create static/js/inspections.js - JavaScript for the inspections page: fetch /api/inspections with pagination/search/filter params, render the table, handle pagination clicks, handle search input, handle filter changes, handle export button clicks (download from /api/export/csv and /api/export/excel), handle 'view' action to show inspection detail modal or expand row.

Add CSS for the inspections page in static/style.css - style the inspections table, search bar, filter controls, export buttons, pagination, and detail modal. Use the same design tokens (--primary-red, --dark-bg, etc.) to maintain visual consistency with the existing site.

Update templates/dashboard.html to add a navigation link for 'History' in the nav-links section (between 'Live Feed' and 'Contact'). Also add a Dashboard Summary section between the live-detection section and the contact section showing key stats.
Add a small stats section in the live-detection area or just below it showing: Total Inspections count, Average Confidence, Largest Crack detected. These update via polling /api/summary.

Update static/js/dashboard.js to: (a) Poll /api/summary every 5 seconds and update the dashboard summary stats section. (b) Ensure the analysis panel continues to display the captured overlay image from /capture/image when a capture completes, while the live feed stays raw.
Update app.py to add the route GET /inspections that renders templates/inspections.html, passing the sources list for the navbar.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /inspections shows the Inspection History page with proper styling matching the existing site
The inspections page loads data from /api/inspections and displays it in a table
Search by capture ID or date filters results
Export CSV and Export Excel buttons trigger downloads
Dashboard summary stats section shows data from /api/summary
Navigation bar includes a link to 'History' (/inspections page)
The live feed in the dashboard shows raw video without overlays
The analysis panel shows the overlay image only after a capture is confirmed
All existing page sections (hero, features, how-it-works, live-detection, contact, footer) remain unchanged in layout and styling
